references.text: Mentions the same peoples: Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites who lived in the land.
Describes how God intended to drive out the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites.
Lists the seven peoples that Israel was to drive out: Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
Mentions Mount Hermon and the area beneath it, corresponding to the Hivite settlement under Hermon.
Describes how the kings on the other side of the Jordan, including the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, gathered together.
Lists the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites whom God intended to drive out.
Mentions Mount Hermon and the area of Mizpah in connection with the defeated kings.
Mentions Mount Hermon and the land beneath it as part of the territory.
Refers to the Hivites who lived on the Lebanon mountains, from Baal-Hermon to Lebo-Hamath.
The promise to Abraham that his descendants would inherit the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites, Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaim, Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites and Jebusites.
